## Milestone 1 - Task 2: Excel Ingestion

Reads a test script from `test-scripts/samples/`, drops empty rows, validates each remaining row, and normalizes it into the shared Test Case JSON schema (docs/architecture/milestone-1.md, section 7, extended with ingestion metadata - see docs/contracts/planner-contract.md).

Each valid row is handed to the **Planner** node wrapped in the standard routing contract. Invalid rows are handed to Planner as a standard ERROR payload instead (docs/contracts/error-payload.md). This workflow does not implement Planner routing logic, API calls, Decision Agent, Documentation Agent or Jira Agent - those stay out of scope.

## Task 2.5: Workflow Standards

`Normalize To Test Case JSON` is the only node that validates row content; `Build Planner Routing Contract` is the only node that decides where a valid test case is routed. Both reuse the shared shapes documented in `docs/contracts/`:

- `docs/contracts/planner-contract.md` - the envelope sent to Planner for valid test cases
- `docs/contracts/error-payload.md` - the shared error object, reused by every future workflow

See `docs/workflow-standards.md` for the naming/versioning conventions every future workflow (API Agent, Decision Agent, Documentation Agent, Jira Agent) must follow.

nodes.notes: Hand-off boundary to the Planner Agent. Receives either a routing contract (valid test case) or an ERROR payload (invalid row) - see docs/contracts/. Planner routing logic itself is not part of Task 2/2.5 and is built in a later task.
